# --description--

当数据可能在多个层级上缺失时，可选链就派上了用场：一个对象本身可能是 `nil`，它的某个属性也可能是 `nil`。
一条 `?.` 链就能处理这两种情况，完全不需要 `if`。

# --instructions--

编写一个函数 `authorName`，参数为 `Book?` 类型的 `of`，返回该书的 `author`；当这本书或它的作者缺失时返回 `"Unknown"`。
保持 `Book` 类不变

# --before-seed--

```swift
// DO NOT EDIT FROM HERE
import Foundation

var _testCount = 0
var _testFailedCount = 0
func tryCatch(_ assertion: Bool) {
    _testCount += 1
    if !assertion {
        _testFailedCount += 1
        print("Test Case '--err-t\(_testCount)--' failed")
    }
}
// DO NOT EDIT UNTIL HERE
```

# --seed--

```swift
class Book {
    var author: String?
}
```

# --asserts--

作者为 `"Ada"` 的书必须返回 `"Ada"`

```swift
let novel = Book()
novel.author = "Ada"
tryCatch(authorName(of: novel) == "Ada")
```

没有作者的书必须返回 `"Unknown"`

```swift
tryCatch(authorName(of: Book()) == "Unknown")
```

`nil` 的书必须返回 `"Unknown"`

```swift
tryCatch(authorName(of: nil) == "Unknown")
```

# --after-asserts--

```swift
print("Executed \(_testCount) tests, with \(_testFailedCount) failures")
```

# --solutions--

```swift
class Book {
    var author: String?
}
func authorName(of book: Book?) -> String {
    return book?.author ?? "Unknown"
}
```
